verdict.rationale: The pack documents no way to version, review, or roll back automations such as alerts, auto top-ups, dunning, or invoice issuance rules. The nearest items are adjacent and do not count: an audit trail of plan assignments on subscriptions, previewing a subscription edit before saving, and testing pricing changes against historical usage. None of these is versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
